status: additional development-cohort analysis, not independent confirmation
timing_pilot: One training-only selector timing pilot with 19 iterations; no prediction errors were used to choose the protocol

polymer_modulus.aggregation: unweighted mean of six region-held-out fold metrics
polymer_modulus.source_exclusion: other source properties only; modulus source omitted in inherited v33 features

metals_volume.aggregation: pooled held-out predictions within each repeat, then mean across repeats and source seeds
metals_volume.source_exclusion: inherited v38/v44 bank excludes target-cohort compositions according to source catalog; no source refit

oxides_formation.aggregation: pooled held-out predictions within each repeat, then mean across repeats and source seeds
oxides_formation.source_exclusion: inherited v38/v44 bank excludes target-cohort compositions according to source catalog; no source refit

krr_fit: training y centered/scaled; alpha added to kernel diagonal
concatenation: append NN, YAE, YVAE latent coordinates in this order at a matched source seed; no latent averaging
protected_columns: all original X, D and applicability mask columns remain in the candidate basis; numerical constant columns are filtered within each fit as in saved prep

boruta.selection: statistically confirmed learned coordinates only; unresolved and rejected learned coordinates excluded
boruta.fitting: full base+latent candidate matrix, training-only constant removal/standardization; fit separately inside every inner fold and once on outer training
boruta.zero_selected: use base only; no forced coordinate fallback
boruta.logging: statistical confirmed/unresolved/rejected, weak rough-fix flag, hit counts, full coordinate decisions
boruta.random_seed: 510000 + case_index*10000 + source_seed*10 + repeat*100 + outer_fold*10 + inner_index; outer refit inner_index=9

selection_order: configuration fixed before target prediction errors from this stage were computed
source_overlap: retain historical target-specific exclusions; do not apply latest bank to original Tc/gap targets
scope_limits: KRR-only additional comparison; original six-regressor benchmark remains unchanged
source models and full source-training data were not retrained/re-audited
same saved development cohorts and splits are reused
polymer boundary route and inorganic whole-composition route are evaluated separately
no claim that latent coordinates identify causal microscopic interactions
